content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIESL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website:aiahl.in . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 06-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIESL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the AIESL Senior Executive Finance posts is 06-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Senior Executive Finance post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Senior Executive Finance position, candidates must be CA/ICWA qualified with a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in finance functions, excluding article ship.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to AIESL posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 62 years for serving or retired PSU employees. For all other candidates, the maximum age limit is 52 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in the AIESL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced by AIESL for the Senior Executive Finance and Executive Finance - Level II positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Executive Finance role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Executive Finance post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 1,30,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for AIESL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIESL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will involve a Personal Interview followed by a Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for AIESL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for AIESL Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What qualifications are required for the Executive Finance - Level II post?
faq.answer: For the Executive Finance - Level II position, candidates need to have completed Inter CA / Inter ICWA / MBA (Finance) from a recognized university with at least 8 years of post-qualification experience.
